name: nzbfast
description: Speed-focused Usenet (NZB) downloader written in Rust. Single small binary, low memory, saturates fast lines with a handful of connections. Verifies articles while they download, so most jobs finish with no separate verify pass; repair and unpack run only when needed. Web dashboard on port 6789 with a SABnzbd-compatible API that works with Sonarr, Radarr and friends out of the box. Drop .nzb files in the watch folder or add them from the dashboard. Set an API key (NZBFAST_APIKEY, shown under Advanced) before connecting *arr apps.

paths.name: Watch
paths.description: Drop an .nzb file here to queue it automatically.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns downloaded files (99 = nobody, the Unraid default).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns downloaded files (100 = users, the Unraid default).

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: API key for Sonarr/Radarr and other automation. Set here, it lives in this template, so it survives every container update and reinstall and your apps never need re-pairing. Leave empty to set one later in the dashboard settings (a key set there wins over this one).
